title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI hooks + flaky-metric tolerances
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: The eval harness currently runs prompt-set checks as a batch step which makes diagnosing prompt-specific regressions difficult and causes noisy CI failures when a single prompt fluctuates. This PR adds per-prompt CI hook support, a small runner that executes prompt buckets independently, and introduces configurable flaky-metric tolerances so minor statistical noise doesn't fail the whole job. Changes are backward-compatible and gated behind a feature flag. Includes docs, tests, and CI wiring. Checklist: - [x] per-prompt runner implementation - [x] CI integration (GitHub Actions) - [x] metric tolerance config and defaults - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] docs + example prompt-set config - [x] rollout plan (feature flag + gradual enable)
commits: 1) add per-prompt-hook runner and orchestrator; 2) wire runner into CI as asynchronous job matrix; 3) add metric_tolerances config and default thresholds; 4) add unit tests + integration test harness; 5) docs and examples; 6) fix lint/style after review
review_comments: Marco Chen: Asked for clearer failure semantics when tolerances are hit; requested explicit log fields for prompt id, metric, baseline, delta. Author: Implemented structured logging and updated tests to assert logs. Samira Ali: Noted potential performance regression when partitioning small prompt-sets; asked for heuristic to avoid overhead. Author: Added shortcut to run grouped mode when prompt count < 8 (configurable). Diego Martinez: Requested CI retry semantics for transient infra failures; added retry policy to GitHub Actions job and documented expected flake behavior.
ci_checks: Initial run: lint failed (flake8) -> fixed; Tests: unit tests pass, integration job failed intermittently on GHA runner -> added retries; Final CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint, typecheck)
release_notes: Add per-prompt CI hooks for eval-harness + configurable metric tolerances to reduce noisy CI failures; feature gated and rolled out behind eval.per_prompt_ci feature flag.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag eval.per_prompt_ci=off by default. To enable progressively, flip flag in config and monitor eval.harness.per_prompt.failure_rate and eval.harness.per_prompt.job_duration metrics. Default tolerance values are conservative and documented in metric_tolerances.yaml.example.
testing_and_validation: Unit tests cover runner logic and tolerance checks. Integration tests run a sample prompt-set matrix on CI. Load test locally with scripts/ci_matrix_generator.py to simulate 1000 prompt evaluations. Observability added: per-prompt metric tags and structured logs for prompt_id, metric, baseline, delta, tolerance_applied.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: misconfigured tolerances could hide real regressions. Mitigation: conservative defaults, rollout behind feature flag, alerting on drift when aggregated failure rate > 2%. Added Linear ticket ENG-4999 for follow-up to expose per-team tuning UI.
user_impact: Developers will see fewer noisy CI failures for eval runs; when tolerances are exceeded the per-prompt job will mark the prompt as flaky and surface details in job artifact. No API changes; behaviour controlled by feature flag and config file.
backport_plan: No backports required; this is an opt-in feature behind a flag. If requested, cherry-pick to release/2025-12 with feature flag off.
examples_and_docs: docs/eval/harness_per_prompt_ci.md contains example config and rollout steps. metric_tolerances.yaml.example documents threshold semantics and examples for common metrics (accuracy, lm_loss, coherence_score).
